competition.title: Competitions
competition.prizeDisclaimer: The client provides and pays for the prize and is responsible for any tax, payroll or legal implications.

masteryMonth.name: Mastery Month
masteryMonth.howToWin: Master the most modules in the period. A module is mastered when you have answered every question in it correctly at least once. Retakes are welcome.
masteryMonth.why: It rewards real knowledge. Trying again is encouraged, not penalised, and speed does not matter.

knowledgeBuilder.name: Knowledge Builder
knowledgeBuilder.howToWin: Answer correctly the most different questions in the period.
knowledgeBuilder.why: It rewards the amount of correct learning, and repeating the same quiz does not help.

learningStreak.name: Learning Streak Challenge
learningStreak.howToWin: Be active in the most weeks in the period. A week counts when you complete at least one lesson or quiz.
learningStreak.why: It encourages little-and-often learning that suits shift work. Each week counts once, and holidays or sickness do not wipe out your progress.

teamShowdown.name: Team Showdown
teamShowdown.howToWin: Teams or sites compete on the percentage of their assigned training completed before the due date.
teamShowdown.why: Percentages are fair to teams and sites of different sizes, a shared goal builds support, and no individual is ranked.

beatTheExpiry.name: Beat the Expiry
beatTheExpiry.howToWin: Complete a refresher before it expires, within the window, to be entered into a random draw. Refreshers done outside the app count once the certificate is approved.
beatTheExpiry.why: It rewards keeping up to date, not speed.

completeAndWin.name: Complete and Win
completeAndWin.howToWin: Complete and pass the chosen modules by the end date to be entered into a random draw.
completeAndWin.why: Everyone who qualifies has an equal chance, so there is no reason to race. It suits must-do training such as the September framework update.

scenarioSavvy.name: Scenario Savvy
scenarioSavvy.howToWin: Choose the best outcome in the most scenario questions. Each question counts once.
scenarioSavvy.why: It rewards good judgement, which is what inspectors want staff to show.

closedBook.name: Closed-Book Challenge
closedBook.howToWin: Answer correctly the most different questions in closed-book mode in the period.
closedBook.why: It rewards recall without notes. Notes are locked in counted attempts. Open-book attempts are still available, they just do not count here.
